QuestInfo.0: Make friends with other fairies that #p1032101# introduces you to.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032101# introduced you to #p1032100#. Rowen said you should bring an #t02010003# to #p1032100# to make a good first impression. Purchase an #b#t02010003##k from the #b#m101000002##k at #m101000000# and bring it to #b#p1032100##k.
QuestInfo.2: Just like #p1032101# said, #p1032100# was really happy to get an #t02010003#. You might be able to make friends with #p1032100# using the same method.

0.0: So #h0#, how are you liking #m101000000#? Maybe it's time you met some of the other fairies here. How about I introduce you to #p1032100#?

yes.0: #p1032100# doesn't like humans very much, but she likes gifts. I suggest bringing #p1032100# some #t02010003#s. Nothing makes us friendly like presents!
yes.1: Now, I'm not saying you should bribe us. No, no, no. I'm saying you should give us lots of gifts! Big difference! Anyway, buy an #b#t02010003##k from the #b#m101000002##k, and bring it to #b#p1032100##k.

no.0: Oh, you just wanted to be friends with me? Tee hee!

1.0: Huh? What do you want? I really don't...\r\nHey, an #t02010003#! I love these. So...what's this all about? You trying to bribe me?

yes.0: Oh, so #p1032101# sent you! That means this isn't a bribe, it's a gift! Nice! #p1032101# has pretty good taste in people, so you must be all right.

npc.0: You can find #b#p1032100##k at the top of Ellinia. Don't forget to buy an #b#t02010003##k for her. You can purchase #b#t02010003#es#k from the #b#m101000002##k. Help our economy!

item.0: What? I am really not in a good mood right now. Don't bother me.
